verdict.rationale: Plausible documents both an Events API (for recording pageviews/custom events) and a Stats API with a /api/v2/query endpoint for programmatic access, which supports AI-native/agentic use to fetch or send analytics data. However, there's no OpenAPI spec, llms.txt, or machine-readable API description discoverable (all probes 404), limiting easy agentic discovery/consumption.
